provenance: Independent requirement-derived development cases; proposed implementation/tests not inspected. No private data source used.
access_classification: Shared workspace development cases, not blind/protected holdouts. Implementer must not alter expectations.
canonical_input_note: Canonical semantic givens require explicit mapping to the public adapter schema; they do not prescribe internal implementation. Network ingress accepts only frozen selectors, never these arbitrary semantic objects.

cloud_score_contract.note: Expected explicit failure/unknown handling can be correct; this is not a successful financial/model result. Existing historical calculator grades stay untouched.
